notes.title: Bokida update : the game is now playable in Chinese!
notes.content:
Today we are adding a new flag to our collection: we're celebrating the addition of Chinese as a supported playable language in Bokida!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/e7f1bd71eec740f723cea2b87435abeb435653e4.jpg[/img]

The new language option will go live later today...
The celebration will be accompanied by a week long sale, starting at 10:00 am PST, to mark this joyous development :-)

We have other content updates planned in the future and we'll be happy to tell you more about that at a later date, stay tuned!

notes.title: New content is coming to Bokida
notes.content:
Completionists and other explorers have reasons to rejoice: we're introducing new content to the game and adding a way to track the location of all of the echoes. Gathering them all will now grant you a special reward...


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/3383ecfcf9cb3e93090805f773630e479c4fe2df.jpg[/img]
 
[h1] Finding all the echoes [/h1] 
One of the temples in the world of Bokida now houses a map that will show Messengers out there where to find all of the echoes of the Dark planet.

This miniature version of the game's environment bears markers that identify the locations of the echoes you might have missed.

 [h1] Complete attunement [/h1] 
Now that the echoes are easier to find, it is also easier to open the gateways that require echoes to be unlocked. 

If you venture through those passages, exploring what lies beyond can lead you to a new, unsuspected place that will react to completely attuned Messengers...
